subject: Solaris Health — on-prem isolation and renewal addendum
messages:
From: Priya Desai <priya.desai@solarishhealth.com>
To: aisha_rahman@redwood.com
Cc: Mark Rudd <mark.rudd@solarishhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 06 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal request — environment separation and capacity increase

Hi Aisha,

We’re coming up on our Redwood renewal (Feb 2027) and want to lock in an expansion path as part of the renewal. Key asks from Solaris Health:
- Provision two additional on‑prem clusters for analytics + inference workloads, isolated from our shared VPC environments.
- Maintain existing retention and audit logging but ensure tenant-level network isolation (airgap preferred for the analytics cluster).
- Extend the term for the private deployment by 12 months and include support for peak burst capacity during Q1 onboarding.

I attached a quick needs assessment (Solaris_Needs_Assessment.pdf) with expected throughput and model mix. Can you share a draft addendum (MSA changes + pricing) and a recommended rollout timeline? Procurement and engineering would like a plan we can review this month.

Thanks,
Priya
Senior Cloud Architect
Solaris Health
[Attachment: Solaris_Needs_Assessment.pdf (pdf)]

---
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>
To: Priya Desai <priya.desai@solarishhealth.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 08 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal request — environment separation and capacity increase

Hi Priya — thanks for the note and the assessment. We can absolutely structure this as a renewal addendum (MSA addendum + scope of work) and stage the isolation rollout to minimize disruption. High‑level proposal:

1) Commercial/term 
- 12 month term extension tied to the new isolated clusters (addendum will enumerate scope).
- One‑time setup fee for on‑prem provisioning and airgap work (TBD in draft).

2) Technical approach
- Two new private clusters: one airgapped analytics cluster, one private inference cluster in your on‑prem DC.
- Staging cluster (non‑airgapped) provisioned first for smoke tests and performance tuning.
- Network & KMS integration to be coordinated with Solaris security.

3) Timeline
- Scoping & approvals: 1–2 weeks
- Procurement & build: 4–6 weeks
- Validation & cutover: 1–2 weeks
- Rough total: 6–10 weeks after signoff (can be compressed with priority provisioning).

Next steps: I’ve attached a draft MSA addendum and a short mutual action plan. Can we set a 30‑minute call this week with your procurement + cloud team to agree milestones and signoff conditions?

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Enterprise Lead, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Draft_MSA_Addendum_SOL-2026-044.docx (docx)]

---
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Priya Desai <priya.desai@solarishhealth.com>, aisha_rahman@redwood.com
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 14:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal request — environment separation and capacity increase

Thanks Priya/Aisha — a few technical clarifications to help size the clusters:

- Workloads: you listed mixed analytical batch jobs and real‑time inference. For the analytics airgapped cluster we recommend a GPU+CPU mix (2x A100‑class GPU nodes plus 8 CPU nodes for preprocessing) to handle offline model retraining and batch embedding jobs.
- Inference cluster: recommend 4x A10/A30 equiv for steady low‑latency traffic; provide autoscale policies for peak bursts.
- Storage & logs: we will mirror audit logs into a customer‑controlled S3/NAS; retention settings will be set from the addendum.
- Networking: true airgap requires manual transfer for model artifacts. If you prefer partial isolation, we can do a VPC‑isolated approach (less lead time).

If Solaris wants the open‑model quantization we discussed, we’ll also include a preflight eval window (2–3 days) on the staging cluster to confirm latency and quality.

—Karthik
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Priya Desai <priya.desai@solarishhealth.com>, aisha_rahman@redwood.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal request — environment separation and capacity increase

Hi team — operations notes and proposed slotting for provisioning:

- Procurement lead time: GPU nodes (A100‑class) typically 4–6 weeks from PO, rack + network provisioning 1–2 weeks.
- Preferred order of work: 1) Network & KMS design (week 1–2) 2) Staging cluster build (week 3–4) 3) Performance tuning & artifact transfer (week 5) 4) Airgap/production cutover (week 6–8).
- Risk items: airgap artifact transfer process (we will need Solaris operator presence for initial model sync), and firmware/networking approvals at your DC.

I’ll draft a concise runbook with owners and calendar slots once procurement timeline is confirmed. Happy to put tentative calendar invites.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Customer Operations, Redwood

Hi Priya/Mark — following internal reviews here’s a proposed commercial term sheet for the addendum (high level):

- Term: +12 months (aligned to renewal window)
- One‑time setup: USD 120,000 (covers airgap procedures, on‑site visits, and staging build)
- Monthly recurring (private clusters + standard support): USD 45,000 / month
- Burst credits: 250k token burst pool included for the first 60 days
- Early sign by 2026‑12‑20: 10% setup credit (reduces one‑time fee)

Attached is the Draft_MSA_Addendum_SOL-2026-044.docx with the proposed redlines for the term and SOW. Next ask: please confirm procurement acceptance of the setup fee and whether Solaris requires alternate invoicing (PO number / purchase order cadence). Once you confirm commercial acceptance we’ll convert this to a formal addendum and start the procurement & scheduling cadence.

Link to deal & SOW: https://hubspot.redwood/deal/SOL-2026-044

Thanks — happy to jump on a call if you want to walk the numbers.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
